name: token-budget
description: Shows this session's token spend against a budget (OMC_RUN_BUDGET_TOKENS or a setting) in a band above the prompt, turning to a warning at 90% and an alert at 100%. Hidden when no budget is set.

budget.title: Token budget
budget.description: Tokens this session may spend before the band turns to an alert. 0 or blank uses OMC_RUN_BUDGET_TOKENS; when both are set, this value wins.
